text:
Gabe Wilson: seeing imaging step crawl in eu-west-1 on the staging pool bring-up. `Imaging` has been running ~58m vs ~12-15m in us-east-1. Anyone else seeing this?

Vanessa Ortiz: yup, I noticed the stage timer in the provisioner events. Which run ID?

Gabe Wilson: run `prov_run_01HPZ7P9G4V6R8D3Q2` (pool `ded-stg-eu1-a100-02`). It’s stuck in "download artifacts".

Gabe Wilson: snippet from provisioner logs:
```text
2024-02-21T17:32:14.981Z  INFO imaging: start image_apply pool=ded-stg-eu1-a100-02 node=i-0b7c6c8e7a...
2024-02-21T17:32:15.104Z  INFO imaging: fetching artifacts mirror=https://artifacts-mirror.eu-west-1.redwoodinfra.net
2024-02-21T17:42:16.332Z  WARN imaging: retrying download attempt=3 err="Get \"https://artifacts-mirror.eu-west-1.redwoodinfra.net/gpu-base/2024.02.19/gpu-base.tar.zst\": net/http: request canceled while waiting for connection (Client.Timeout exceeded)"
2024-02-21T17:52:17.901Z  WARN imaging: retrying download attempt=4 backoff=300s
2024-02-21T18:02:19.443Z ERROR imaging: download failed err="checksum mismatch for gpu-base.tar.zst" mirror=https://artifacts-mirror.eu-west-1.redwoodinfra.net
2024-02-21T18:02:19.444Z  INFO imaging: will retry with clean cache dir
```

Harish Reddy: can confirm from the operator side, the instance is up but cloud-init is basically waiting on that tarball. Similar symptom last week in eu-west-1.

Victor Alvarez: is it actually network/TLS to the mirror or just slow IO? Any packet loss from those nodes?

Gabe Wilson: TLS handshakes look fine, but the mirror endpoint is intermittently timing out. Also the checksum mismatch is worrying.

Nina Petrova: checksum mismatch smells like partial content served / corrupted object on the mirror. If mirror is backing from S3 replication, maybe replication lag and we’re hitting a half-updated artifact?

Vanessa Ortiz: do we have an override to force artifact source to us-east-1 for now?

Gabe Wilson: yeah, there’s an env var in the imaging job (`ARTIFACT_MIRROR_URL`). Default is region-local. We can set it to `https://artifacts.us-east-1.redwoodinfra.net` to unstick.

Sahana Iyer: :eyes: if this is mirror corruption, we should also invalidate the eu-west-1 cache. Who owns the mirror sync job?

Keiko Yamamoto: infra has the mirror sync. also: the checksum mismatch might trigger our retry loop forever-ish (download -> mismatch -> clean cache -> retry). Might be why the stage timer is huge.

Vanessa Ortiz: ok short-term workaround: pin `ARTIFACT_MIRROR_URL` to us-east-1 for eu-west-1 pools until mirror is fixed. Can we do this without a code deploy?

Gabe Wilson: for this run, yes (re-run imaging stage with override). For future, we can add a region allowlist override in config (or a guardrail rule in the provisioner) but that’s a PR.

Harish Reddy: what’s the safest way to rerun? `rw fleet provision rerun --pool ded-stg-eu1-a100-02 --stage imaging --set ARTIFACT_MIRROR_URL=...` ?

Gabe Wilson: exactly. command:
```bash
rw fleet provision rerun \
  --pool ded-stg-eu1-a100-02 \
  --stage imaging \
  --env ARTIFACT_MIRROR_URL=https://artifacts.us-east-1.redwoodinfra.net
```

Victor Alvarez: any concern about cross-region egress cost? (probably fine for a one-off but if we do it for all eu-west pools it adds up)

Vanessa Ortiz: agreed, but better than 2h imaging and failed bring-ups. This is staging, so let’s unblock and file follow-up.

Gabe Wilson: I’ll open a Linear issue for mirror fallback + detection. This should map to the imaging failure-mode we were tracking.

Gabe Wilson: created ENG-2757 “Failure mode: imaging step timeouts on specific SKU/region; add detection + fallback (alternate image mirror or prewarm).” linking logs + run ID.

Sahana Iyer: also please add a check that if checksum mismatch happens N times, we fail fast with a clear error (“mirror corrupted, try alternate mirror”) instead of retrying silently.

Vanessa Ortiz: +1. Also can we get a quick ping to whoever owns artifacts mirror to verify the 2024.02.19 image in eu-west-1 is healthy?

Gabe Wilson: I’ll DM Irene + Nina? (or whoever is on mirror duty). In the meantime Harish, can you rerun imaging with the override and report back.

Harish Reddy: running rerun now. will update.

Harish Reddy: update: rerun started, download is flying now. imaging step at ~4m and progressing. looks like it was purely mirror-side.

Victor Alvarez: ok that points away from node networking. mirror endpoint likely unhealthy or serving bad content.

Nina Petrova: action item: validate mirror replication integrity + add fallback policy: “if mirror errors/timeouts/checksum mismatch -> switch to primary and emit event”.

Vanessa Ortiz: thanks all. Let’s keep the workaround documented in the provisioning runbook draft (imaging slow in eu-west-1 -> override mirror). Gabe please paste the log snippet + command in #eng-infra runbook doc when you get a sec.

Gabe Wilson: will do. also adding a metric dimension for mirror host so we can see if it’s concentrated on `artifacts-mirror.eu-west-1...`.

Keiko Yamamoto: :thumbsup: please also add a guardrail: if imaging p95 > X in a region, alert in the time-to-ready dashboard so we catch it before customer pilot.

Vanessa Ortiz: yep, capture that under ENG-2749/alerts. Closing loop once mirror owner confirms fix.
